subject: Next steps: MAP draft and adjusted commit window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@sagegrid.com>, Todd Whitman <todd.whitman@sagegrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: MAP draft and adjusted commit window

Hi Nora, Todd —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and the MAP draft attached (SageGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key points and open items we agreed to capture: 

- Target close window: end of May (you said internal approval expected in late May, tentative)
- Pilot scope: 2 clinics, read-only integration to start, performance targeting 95th p95 < 400ms token latencies
- Security/compliance: SageGrid requested SOC2 evidence and network architecture diagram (see dependencies)
- Legal/Procurement: Early redlines expected around data residency and indemnity; Nora to share procurement timeline

Immediate next steps (owners):
- SageGrid: confirm final approver list and procurement timeline (Nora)
- Redwood: provide SOC2 artifact and data flow diagram (Marissa / Monica) — deliver by 2028-04-04
- Redwood: update MAP with prioritized milestones and responsibilities (Ben) — deliver v2 by 2028-04-03
- Joint: schedule a 30-min checkpoint for rebaseline and move-to-contract discussion (week of Apr 3)

Dependencies called out in the MAP: legal sign-off, SOC2 artifacts, pilot environment provisioned by SageGrid, and API integration window for the in-house engineering team. I flagged the pilot performance POC as a potential gating item for an earlier smaller-scope pilot if approvals slip.

Attachment: [Attachment: SageGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Ben shares the v2 map.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Todd Whitman <todd.whitman@sagegrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@sagegrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP draft and adjusted commit window

Marissa — thanks for the crisp summary. Couple of updates from our side after an internal sync: 

1) The executive board pushed our procurement approval out to the end of May. That shifts our committed close to ~2028-05-31, earlier guidance was optimistic.
2) We still want to keep the pilot timeline aggressive, but we need to reprioritize milestones so procurement/legal are not on the critical path for early integration testing.
3) Immediate asks from our team: 
   - Formal SOC2 evidence (type II) and a short note on data retention — we need this by 2028-04-14 to share with security reviewers.
   - A slimmed down integration checklist so our engineers can start API work before the legal finish (token-based read-only endpoint, sandbox keys).

I’ve copied our engineering lead, Nora, who will coordinate the sandbox access and will confirm dates for the pilot environment. We appreciate Redwood's flexibility here — proposal: push the official contract target to 2028-05-31 and run a two-phase MAP where integration & sandbox testing are Phase 1 (April/May) and procurement/contract finalization is Phase 2 (May end).

Todd
Director of Partnerships | SageGrid Health
todd.whitman@sagegrid.com | +1 (617) 555-0112
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@sagegrid.com>, Todd Whitman <todd.whitman@sagegrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP draft and adjusted commit window

Nora / Todd — appreciate the heads-up on the board timeline. I took a pass on the MAP with the two-phase approach and attached a reworked draft (SageGrid_MAP_v2.xlsx). High-level changes in v2: 

- Updated target close date: 2028-05-31 (moved from end of Apr)
- Split milestones into Phase 1 (Integration & Pilot) and Phase 2 (Procurement & Contracting) with clear owners and success criteria
- Prioritized the sandbox/API checklist so SageGrid engineering can start integration work in parallel with procurement reviews
- Flagged gating dependency: SOC2 artifact delivery by Redwood by 2028-04-14 — Monica will own the delivery and will share the secure link once uploaded to your SFTP.

Proposed milestone highlights (dates are suggested):
- P1.1 Sandbox provisioned & credentials issued — owner: SageGrid (target: 2028-04-07)
- P1.2 Integration smoke test complete (low-volume) — owner: SageGrid + Redwood (target: 2028-04-21)
- P1.3 Performance POC (2 clinics) — owner: Red/SG engs (target: 2028-05-10)
- P2.1 Legal playbook review complete — owner: SageGrid Legal (target: 2028-05-17)
- P2.2 Contract signature — owner: Mutual (target: 2028-05-31)

Next actions I propose: 30-minute alignment call on Wed Apr 4 or Thu Apr 5 to lock down owners and confirm sandbox delivery date. If Wed works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachment: [Attachment: SageGrid_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (408) 555-0133

Thanks Ben / Todd —

This looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Quick confirmation list and the plan I’ll action: 

- Redwood (Monica) will upload SOC2 type II artifacts and the short data-retention note to the secure folder by 2028-04-14. Monica — can you confirm when the link is live?
- SageGrid to provision sandbox by 2028-04-07 so P1.1 can start. Nora — if the 7th is tight, propose alternatives; we can be flexible but want at least a week of integration before smoke tests.
- Ben to send final v2 MAP by end of day and we’ll use that as the operational checklist for the call.
- Marissa to schedule the alignment call: Wed 2028-04-04 11:00 AM PT (30m) — invite sent.
